definitions.page: A page identifier discovered from a Stage 1 gold flat file or Stage 2 MDF file.
definitions.stage1_page_count: Number of pages with a *_stage1_GOLD_flat.txt file.
definitions.stage2_page_count: Number of pages with a *.mdf.txt file.
definitions.rows: Number of Stage 1 TSV body rows; header and footer rows are excluded. Null when the page has no TSV.
definitions.columns: Number of distinct non-metadata Stage 1 TSV column_id values, summed across pages for dictionary totals.
definitions.gold_grapheme_count: Stage 1 gold graphemes after evaluation normalization, with Unicode punctuation, whitespace, meta, and space labels excluded.
definitions.language_script_graphemes: Gold grapheme counts grouped by validated Stage 1 language-script label.
definitions.bold_tag_count: Exact opening <b> tag occurrences in raw Stage 1 gold flat text.
definitions.italic_tag_count: Exact opening <i> tag occurrences in raw Stage 1 gold flat text.
definitions.tags: Total Stage 2 MDF field-marker occurrences, summed across pages for dictionary totals.
definitions.unique_tags: Distinct Stage 2 MDF field markers; dictionary totals are distinct across all of its pages.
definitions.null_metric: The source artifact for that metric is unavailable for the page or dictionary.
